org_ref.name: EXP
org_ref.mission: EXP's mission is to understand, innovate, partner, and deliver engineering, architecture, design, and consulting services. org_ref.description: EXP is a multidisciplinary firm offering engineering, architecture, design, and consulting services for the built and natural environments. With a heritage dating back to 1906, it unites diverse professionals to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions globally. EXP is an employee-owned company, driven by passion for clients, employees, and communities.
